subject: xlsx-budget-model-audit
certified_statement: xlsx dialect read this self-authored quarterly cost budget workbook at cell/formula-dependency level and machine-checked it against 13 rule instances; result is 5 error-level findings, 2 warning-level findings, and 4 deliberately undetectable defect classes documented in graph/limits.json.
disclaimer: 本证书只说「机器判据跑了什么、报了什么」，不是无损保证、不是财务审计意见、不是对该工作簿业务正确性的背书。素材为自造教学用例，非真实客户数据（见 README「口径声明」）。三条公式类规则未在真实财务模型上验证过假阳性率。
